svg.title: fig04
svg.desc: Figure 4 | Performance improvement across different environments. (a,b) Reference/optimized complete-process wall-time and total-CPU ratios for ten registered family-by-robot-count cells. Squares show point estimates and horizontal whiskers show registered 95% bootstrap intervals. (c) Optimized/ reference peak-RSS ratios. The dashed line is unity; the red dotted line is the registered 1.05 RSS-ratio ceiling. Row codes are O: one fixed open map; M: perfect maze; L, D, H: fractal low, medium, high. The number following each code is robot count. Each cell contains 20 scenes. Stochastic-map intervals resample map blocks and missions; open-map intervals resample missions within one fixed map. Across 200 scenes, all semantic and position pairs match exactly, 199 scenes pass task-validity checks, and one inherited contact is retained. All 2,082 processes completed, including 82 warm-ups and 2,000 measured runs. Wall speedups span 1.2128–1.3398× and CPU speedups 1.2397–1.3560× on host 1. Memory remains approximately unchanged; independent host replication is pending.
